source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Sam y Karla caminan por la avenida grande del pueblo.
sentences.english: Sam and Karla walk along the big avenue of the village.

sentences.text: Hay mucha gente, y casi todos van a la esquina, donde está el supermercado.
sentences.english: There are lots of people, and almost all of them are going to the corner where the supermarket is.

sentences.text: Al comienzo del mes, Sam apenas comprendía un aviso.
sentences.english: At the start of the month Sam could hardly understand a notice.

sentences.text: Ahora ha descubierto que los avisos son una buena escuela.
sentences.english: Now he has discovered that notices are a good school.

sentences.text: Aún no lo comprende todo, y tampoco quiere dejar de intentar.
sentences.english: He doesn't understand everything yet, and he doesn't want to stop trying either.

sentences.text: Karla, mirá ese aviso.
sentences.english: Karla, look at that notice.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Qué dice?
sentences.english: What does it say?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Dice: «Favor no estacionar aquí».
sentences.english: It says: "Please do not park here."
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Es un aviso para los carros.
sentences.english: It is a notice for cars.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Favor no estacionar aquí.
sentences.english: Please do not park here.

sentences.text: Privado.
sentences.english: Private.

sentences.text: No se permite estacionar.
sentences.english: Parking is not permitted.

sentences.text: ¿Y qué quiere decir «privado»?
sentences.english: And what does "privado" mean?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Quiere decir que no es público.
sentences.english: It means that it is not public.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Es solo para los empleados de la empresa.
sentences.english: It is only for the company's employees.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Entonces ese carro de la esquina no puede estar ahí.
sentences.english: Then that car on the corner can't be there.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: No puede.
sentences.english: It can't.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: El aviso lo indica, y ese carro impide el camino a otros.
sentences.english: The notice indicates it, and that car blocks the way for others.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Y mirá: el jefe de la empresa ya está hablando con el empleado.
sentences.english: And look: the company's boss is already talking to the employee.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: ¡Y el empleado tiene una sonrisa!
sentences.english: And the employee has a smile!
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Intenta explicar algo y nadie lo escucha.
sentences.english: He is trying to explain something and nobody listens to him.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Luis llega en su carro y se detiene en la esquina.
sentences.english: Luis arrives in his car and stops at the corner.

sentences.text: Quiere llevarlos al supermercado.
sentences.english: He wants to take them to the supermarket.

sentences.text: Karla se sube con Sam, y los tres platican un poco.
sentences.english: Karla gets in with Sam, and the three of them chat a little.

sentences.text: Hoy es sábado y hay mucha gente en la avenida.
sentences.english: Today is Saturday and there are a lot of people on the avenue.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Yo manejo con cuidado, pero no quiero llegar tarde.
sentences.english: I drive carefully, but I don't want to be late.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Luis, ¿se dice «manejar» o «conducir»?
sentences.english: Luis, do you say "manejar" or "conducir"?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Aquí decimos «manejar».
sentences.english: Here we say "manejar".
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: En otros países dicen «conducir».
sentences.english: In other countries they say "conducir".
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Los dos están bien.
sentences.english: Both are fine.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Yo jamás he manejado un carro aquí.
sentences.english: I have never driven a car here.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Se permite manejar con un pasaporte de otro país?
sentences.english: Is it permitted to drive with a passport from another country?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: No, con el pasaporte no se permite.
sentences.english: No, with a passport it is not permitted.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Hay que obtener otra tarjeta del gobierno.
sentences.english: You have to obtain another card from the government.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Conduzca con cuidado.
sentences.english: Drive carefully.

sentences.text: Deténgase aquí.
sentences.english: Stop here.

sentences.text: No cruce la avenida.
sentences.english: Do not cross the avenue.

sentences.text: Cruce en la esquina.
sentences.english: Cross at the corner.

sentences.text: ¿Se permite cruzar la avenida en otro lugar?
sentences.english: Is it permitted to cross the avenue in another place?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Solo en la esquina.
sentences.english: Only at the corner.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Los carros están obligados a detenerse ahí.
sentences.english: Cars are required to stop there.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Y hoy hay lluvia, que impide ver bien.
sentences.english: And today there is rain, which makes it hard to see.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Por eso hay que cruzar con mucho cuidado.
sentences.english: That's why you have to cross very carefully.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Nadie nos obliga a correr.
sentences.english: Nobody forces us to run.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Luis recibe una llamada de Ana desde el hospital.
sentences.english: Luis receives a call from Ana at the hospital.

sentences.text: Ana anuncia que va a llegar tarde, porque todavía no ha comido.
sentences.english: Ana announces that she is going to be late, because she hasn't eaten yet.

sentences.text: Luis se ríe, y Karla también.
sentences.english: Luis laughs, and Karla does too.

sentences.text: Continúan el viaje con la risa de Luis en el carro.
sentences.english: They continue the trip with Luis's laughter in the car.

sentences.text: El supermercado tiene mucha gente.
sentences.english: The supermarket is crowded.

sentences.text: Hay una oferta grande de arroz y de frijoles, y un anuncio rojo en la calle.
sentences.english: There is a big offer on rice and beans, and a red notice in the street.

sentences.text: Oferta de la semana.
sentences.english: Offer of the week.

sentences.text: Pase por la caja.
sentences.english: Go through the checkout.

sentences.text: No deje sus bolsas aquí.
sentences.english: Do not leave your bags here.

sentences.text: Gracias por su compra.
sentences.english: Thank you for your purchase.

sentences.text: Karla, ¿qué es una oferta?
sentences.english: Karla, what is an offer?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Es un precio mejor que el de siempre.
sentences.english: It is a better price than usual.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Mirá aquí: el arroz cuesta menos hoy.
sentences.english: Look here: the rice costs less today.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: El supermercado anuncia la oferta cada semana.
sentences.english: The supermarket announces the offer every week.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Noto que casi nadie usa tarjeta aquí.
sentences.english: I notice that almost nobody uses a card here.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Yo sí la uso, porque ya no quiero andar con mucho dinero.
sentences.english: I do, because I no longer want to walk around with a lot of money.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Y esa venta de plátanos allá, en la calle?
sentences.english: And that banana sale over there, in the street?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Es una venta pequeña.
sentences.english: It is a small sale.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: La compra la hacés allá, no aquí.
sentences.english: You make the purchase over there, not here.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Aceptan dinero, pero no tarjeta.
sentences.english: They accept money, but not a card.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: En la caja, Sam presenta su tarjeta.
sentences.english: At the checkout, Sam presents his card.

sentences.text: La mujer de la caja lo mira con una sonrisa.
sentences.english: The woman at the register looks at him with a smile.

sentences.text: Buenas tardes.
sentences.english: Good afternoon.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Presente su tarjeta, por favor.
sentences.english: Present your card, please.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Firme aquí.
sentences.english: Sign here.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Gracias.
sentences.english: Thank you.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Dónde pongo mi nombre?
sentences.english: Where do I put my name?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Firme en este lugar.
sentences.english: Sign in this place.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Revise el precio antes de pagar.
sentences.english: Check the price before you pay.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Está bien.
sentences.english: That's fine.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿La compra incluye las bolsas?
sentences.english: Does the purchase include the bags?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Sí, el precio incluye todo.
sentences.english: Yes, the price includes everything.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Que tenga un buen día.
sentences.english: Have a good day.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Después de comprar, Karla y Sam entran en un restaurante pequeño de la avenida.
sentences.english: After shopping, Karla and Sam go into a small restaurant on the avenue.

sentences.text: El restaurante es público: todos pueden entrar.
sentences.english: The restaurant is public: everyone can come in.

sentences.text: En general, la comida es buena y barata.
sentences.english: In general, the food is good and cheap.

sentences.text: Hoy: sopa de pollo, arroz y frijoles.
sentences.english: Today: chicken soup, rice and beans.

sentences.text: Esta sopa me recuerda la sopa de doña Marta.
sentences.english: This soup reminds me of doña Marta's soup.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Voy a darte la receta en casa.
sentences.english: I'll give you the recipe at home.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Comen, platican y ríen mucho.
sentences.english: They eat, chat and laugh a lot.

sentences.text: El restaurante anuncia sus precios en la calle, y hoy la comida incluye pan.
sentences.english: The restaurant announces its prices in the street, and today the meal includes bread.

sentences.text: Después dan una vuelta por la avenida antes de volver a casa.
sentences.english: Afterwards they take a walk along the avenue before going home.

sentences.text: Después, Sam necesita ir al banco.
sentences.english: Afterwards Sam needs to go to the bank.

sentences.text: Quiere abrir una cuenta pequeña para pagar el cuarto.
sentences.english: He wants to open a small account to pay for the room.

sentences.text: Karla presenta a Sam al hombre del banco, que es amable y lo ayuda.
sentences.english: Karla introduces Sam to the man at the bank, who is kind and helps him.

sentences.text: Buenas tardes.
sentences.english: Good afternoon.
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.text: Presente su pasaporte, por favor.
sentences.english: Present your passport, please.
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.text: Indique su nombre y su número de teléfono.
sentences.english: Indicate your name and your telephone number.
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.text: Aquí tiene.
sentences.english: Here you are.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Algo más?
sentences.english: Anything else?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Revise su nombre, y escriba su número.
sentences.english: Check your name, and write your number.
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.text: Informe al banco de todo cambio.
sentences.english: Inform the bank of every change.
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.text: Karla, no entiendo la palabra «informe».
sentences.english: Karla, I don't understand the word "informe".
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Es una palabra como «venir»?
sentences.english: Is it a word like "venir"?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Sí.
sentences.english: Yes.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: «Informe» es la forma para «usted».
sentences.english: "Informe" is the form for "usted".
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: El banco te habla de «usted».
sentences.english: The bank addresses you as "usted".
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Entonces con dos personas tengo que cambiar la palabra.
sentences.english: So with two people I have to change the word.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Así es.
sentences.english: That's right.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Si hablás con muchas personas, decís «vengan», «esperen», «pasen».
sentences.english: If you speak with many people, you say "vengan", "esperen", "pasen".
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Esa noche, Karla le da una receta a Sam.
sentences.english: That night Karla gives Sam a recipe.

sentences.text: Es la sopa de pollo de doña Marta, desde el comienzo hasta la olla.
sentences.english: It is doña Marta's chicken soup, from the beginning to the pot.

sentences.text: La receta indica poca sal.
sentences.english: The recipe indicates little salt.

sentences.text: Sopa de pollo.
sentences.english: Chicken soup.

sentences.text: Cortar el pollo.
sentences.english: To cut the chicken.

sentences.text: Calentar un poco de aceite en la olla.
sentences.english: To heat a little oil in the pot.

sentences.text: Fría la cebolla y el tomate.
sentences.english: Fry the onion and the tomato.

sentences.text: Agregue el pollo y una cuchara de sal.
sentences.english: Add the chicken and a spoonful of salt.

sentences.text: Prepare las verduras y póngalas en la olla.
sentences.english: Prepare the vegetables and put them in the pot.

sentences.text: No cubra la olla del todo.
sentences.english: Do not cover the pot completely.

sentences.text: Sirva la sopa en los platos.
sentences.english: Serve the soup on the plates.

sentences.text: Karla, esta receta es muy buena.
sentences.english: Karla, this recipe is very good.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Voy a prepararla el domingo.
sentences.english: I am going to prepare it on Sunday.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Y no te olvidés: la sal, poca.
sentences.english: And don't forget: little salt.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Si te equivocás, la sopa no sirve.
sentences.english: If you make a mistake, the soup is no good.
sentences.speaker: K

sections.title: Las reglas de la casa del equipo

sentences.text: En la pared del hogar de Karla hay un aviso.
sentences.english: On the wall of Karla's home there is a notice.

sentences.text: Es para el equipo que llega en julio.
sentences.english: It is for the team that arrives in July.

sentences.text: Karla lo escribió hace un año, y lo ha revisado muchas veces.
sentences.english: Karla wrote it a year ago, and she has revised it many times.

sentences.text: El pastor Mario le ha mencionado que el equipo llega con quince personas.
sentences.english: Pastor Mario has mentioned to her that the team is arriving with fifteen people.

sentences.text: Avisos del hogar.
sentences.english: Notices of the home.

sentences.text: Apaguen la luz al salir.
sentences.english: Turn off the light when leaving.

sentences.text: Enciendan solo la luz del comedor.
sentences.english: Turn on only the dining-room light.

sentences.text: Guarden los vasos y las tazas.
sentences.english: Put away the glasses and the cups.

sentences.text: Saquen la basura por la noche.
sentences.english: Take out the rubbish at night.

sentences.text: Ordenen su dormitorio.
sentences.english: Tidy your bedroom.

sentences.text: Coloquen la manta y la almohada en el armario.
sentences.english: Put the blanket and the pillow in the wardrobe.

sentences.text: Barran la sala y muevan el sofá cada semana.
sentences.english: Sweep the living room and move the sofa every week.

sentences.text: Llenen la jarra del agua.
sentences.english: Fill the water jug.

sentences.text: No tiren nada en el piso.
sentences.english: Do not throw anything on the floor.

sentences.text: Callen después de las diez.
sentences.english: Be quiet after ten.

sentences.text: Quiten los zapatos en la sala.
sentences.english: Take off your shoes in the living room.

sentences.text: Agarren solo sus cosas, y metan las bolsas en el armario.
sentences.english: Take only your own things, and put the bags in the wardrobe.

sentences.text: Anden con cuidado en el patio.
sentences.english: Walk carefully in the courtyard.

sentences.text: No paren en la sala: pasen al comedor.
sentences.english: Do not stop in the living room: go on to the dining room.

sentences.text: Abran la cortina por la mañana.
sentences.english: Open the curtain in the morning.

sentences.text: No impidan el camino en la habitación.
sentences.english: Do not block the way in the room.

sentences.text: Este aviso es general.
sentences.english: This notice is general.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: No obliga a nadie, pero ayuda a todos.
sentences.english: It does not oblige anyone, but it helps everyone.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Me gusta.
sentences.english: I like it.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Es claro.
sentences.english: It is clear.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Resuelve muchos problemas, y no dudo que todos van a obedecerlo.
sentences.english: It solves many problems, and I don't doubt that everyone will obey it.
sentences.speaker: S

sections.title: Dos estaciones y un anuncio de la iglesia

sentences.text: El domingo, en la iglesia, la hermana Elena lee un anuncio para todos.
sentences.english: On Sunday, at church, sister Elena reads an announcement for everyone.

sentences.text: Hermanos, escuchen.
sentences.english: Brothers and sisters, listen.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: En este país hay dos estaciones: el verano y el invierno.
sentences.english: In this country there are two seasons: summer and winter.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: En cada estación llueve de forma diferente.
sentences.english: In each season it rains differently.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: En esta estación llueve mucho, y las calles se llenan de agua.
sentences.english: In this season it rains a lot, and the streets fill with water.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Por eso la iglesia informa a todos: ustedes pueden dejar sus carros en el patio, pero no estacionen aquí.
sentences.english: That's why the church informs everyone: you can leave your cars in the courtyard, but do not park here.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Pasen por la mesa, firmen aquí y revisen su nombre.
sentences.english: Go to the table, sign here and check your name.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Presenten a los amigos nuevos.
sentences.english: Introduce the new friends.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: La iglesia anuncia que cada persona es bienvenida.
sentences.english: The church announces that every person is welcome.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: La reunión general es el sábado.
sentences.english: The general meeting is on Saturday.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: El inicio es a las ocho.
sentences.english: The start is at eight.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: La reunión es pública, pero la comida es privada, solo para el equipo, y también incluye sopa.
sentences.english: The meeting is public, but the meal is private, only for the team, and also includes soup.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Anuncio nuevo: hay una venta de pan en el patio.
sentences.english: New announcement: there is a bread sale in the courtyard.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: La compra de cada pan ayuda a la clínica.
sentences.english: Buying each loaf helps the clinic.
sentences.speaker: E
